# Strapi contributor docs

> How Strapi is built, and how to contribute to it

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Strapi (WIP)](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/Strapi): Central Strapi class that manages project configuration, directories, and instance state.
- [API (WIP)](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/API): Module that wraps functionalities around Strapi endpoint generation.
- [Container](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/container): Container module that provides dependency injection and service registration.
- [Cron Service](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/Cron): Service that provides a way to add, remove, start, and stop cron jobs.
- [EventHub (WIP)](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/EventHub): Event Hub module for managing and dispatching events in Strapi.
- [Startup Logger](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/StartupLogger): Logger that displays startup information and statistics about the Strapi instance.
- [StrapiFS (WIP)](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/StrapiFS): Wrapper around Node.js FS module to manipulate and manage local files.
- [Strapi server (WIP)](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/strapi-server): Module that generates and configures the Strapi HTTP server.
- [Telemetry Service](https://contributor.strapi.io/api/Telemetry): Service that collects and sends anonymous usage data for Strapi improvement.
- [Package map](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/package-map): Interactive map of the workspace packages under packages/ and their internal dependencies, built from each package.json.
- [Server lifecycle](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/server-lifecycle): The order in which the Strapi server is constructed, loaded, started and destroyed, and what each phase makes available.
- [Container and registries](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/container-and-registries): How the Strapi container stores core subsystems, how registries store plugin, API and application artifacts, and how UIDs are built.
- [Extension points](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/extension-points): The mechanisms that plugins and application code use to change Strapi server behavior, in the order in which they apply.
- [Document write path](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/document-write-path): What happens between a call to strapi.documents(uid).create, update or publish and the webhook that reports it.
- [HTTP request path](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/http-request-path): How Strapi handles an HTTP request from Koa to the response, for the Content API and the admin API.
- [Schema sync](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/schema-sync): How Strapi turns content-type and component schemas into database tables at startup, with the schema diff, sync hooks and migrations.
- [Sessions and JWT](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/authentication): How admin and Content API authentication works with SessionManager, tokens, and configuration.
- [Enterprise Edition](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/enterprise-edition): Overview of Strapi Enterprise Edition features and capabilities.
- [Future Flags](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/future-flags): Feature flags that enable unstable features for testing and community feedback.
- [Glossary](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture/glossary): Terms used in the Strapi server codebase, with the naming traps that confuse new contributors.
- [Architecture overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/architecture): How the main parts of Strapi fit together at runtime, and which architecture pages to read first.
- [Contributing to Strapi](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/contributing-guide): The contribution process for the Strapi monorepo, imported from the CONTRIBUTING.md file at the repository root.
- [Code of conduct](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/code-of-conduct): The rules for taking part in the Strapi community, imported from the CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md file at the repository root.
- [Setup](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/testing/e2e/setup): Guide to setting up and running end-to-end tests with Playwright.
- [App Template](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/testing/e2e/app-template): Template and configuration for e2e test applications.
- [Data Transfer](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/testing/e2e/data-transfer): Guide to data transfer setup and usage in e2e testing.
- [Testing](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/testing): The test types of the Strapi monorepo (unit, front-end, TypeScript, API integration, CLI and E2E) and the command that runs each one.
- [FE Coding Guidelines](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/frontend-guidelines): Frontend coding guidelines and best practices for Strapi admin development.
- [Typescript](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/typescript): TypeScript usage conventions and guidelines for Strapi codebase.
- [Working with the Design System](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/design-system): Design system documentation and component usage guidelines.
- [Writing docs](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/writing-docs): Conventions for these contributor docs, covering where content goes, frontmatter, page status, package pages, links and the local workflow.
- [Docs health](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing/docs-health): Generated report of the pages flagged as stub, draft or needs-review, and of the packages that have no real documentation yet.
- [Contributing](https://contributor.strapi.io/contributing): How to contribute to the Strapi monorepo, with guides for testing, front-end and TypeScript conventions, and for writing these docs.
- [@strapi/admin-test-utils](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/admin-test-utils): Setup and fixtures for testing the admin panel
- [@strapi/cloud-cli](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/cli/cloud): CLI commands for Strapi Cloud interactions
- [create-strapi](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/cli/create-strapi): Alias CLI for creating new Strapi projects via npm init
- [create-strapi-app](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/cli/create-strapi-app): CLI to scaffold a new Strapi project
- [Audit Logs](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/ee/audit-logs): Guide for Audit Logs
- [useLicenseLimits](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/ee/hooks/use-license-limits): API reference for the useLicenseLimits hook
- [useAdminRoles](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/features/hooks/use-admin-roles): API reference for the useAdminRoles hook
- [useEnterprise](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/features/hooks/use-enterprise): API reference for the useEnterprise hook
- [NPS](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/features/nps): Net Promoter Score survey that collects user feedback about Strapi.
- [Admin telemetry (frontend)](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/features/telemetry): How the admin panel sends usage events from the browser — useTracking, event types, and plugin patterns.
- [Guided Tour](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/guided-tour): Interactive onboarding system that guides new users through key features and workflows.
- [useContentTypes](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/hooks/use-content-types): API reference for the useContentTypes hook in Strapi's Content Manager
- [usePersistentState](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/hooks/use-persistent-state): API reference for the usePersistentState hook in Strapi
- [@strapi/admin](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin): React admin panel and its server part: admin users, roles, RBAC, tokens, admin authentication and admin routes.
- [Introduction](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/permissions/intro): Introduction to admin panel permission system and access control.
- [How Permissions Work](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/permissions/how-they-work): Explanation of how permissions are evaluated and enforced in admin.
- [Fetching Permissions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/permissions/frontend/fetching-permissions): Guide to fetching and retrieving user permissions in frontend.
- [Using Permissions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/admin/permissions/frontend/using-permissions): Guide to checking and using permissions in frontend components.
- [Documents](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/documents): An introduction to documents in the content-manager
- [Layouts](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/layouts): How layouts work with the List & Edit view
- [RBAC](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/RBAC): How RBAC work with documents in the content-manager
- [Content Releases](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/content-releases): Guide for content releases in the content-manager.
- [Relations](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/relations): Conceptual guide to relations in the Content Manager focussing on the technical decisions taken.
- [Blocks editor](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/blocks): The modern JSON-based rich text editor
- [Live preview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/preview): Frontend-agnostic preview with visual editing
- [useDocumentActions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/hooks/use-document-actions): API reference for the useDocumentActions hook from Strapi's Content Manager
- [useDocument](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/hooks/use-document): API reference for the useDocument hook from Strapi's Content Manager
- [useDragAndDrop](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/hooks/use-drag-and-drop): API reference for the useDragAndDrop hook in Strapi's Content Manager
- [@strapi/content-manager](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager): Core plugin with the admin panel list, edit and configuration views for documents, and the admin API routes behind them.
- [Permission Checker](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-manager/services/permission-checker): Service that enforces access control by checking permissions and sanitizing user actions.
- [Backend Design](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases/backend): Content Releases backend
- [Introduction](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases/frontend/intro): Introduction to content releases frontend implementation and features.
- [Releases page](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases/frontend/releases-page): Documentation of the content releases page user interface.
- [Release details page](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases/frontend/release-details-page): Documentation of the release details page and its functionality.
- [Content Releases Scheduling](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases/scheduling): Content Releases Scheduling
- [@strapi/content-releases](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-releases): Enterprise core plugin that groups documents into releases and publishes or unpublishes them together, now or on a schedule.
- [Content structure file](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-type-builder/content-structure): The version 1 folder-group configuration for Content Type Builder
- [@strapi/content-type-builder](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/content-type-builder): Core plugin that creates and edits content types, components and folder groups from the admin panel by writing schema files.
- [Introduction](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/configuration/intro): Introduction to Strapi core configuration system and options.
- [Recommended security defaults](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/configuration/security-defaults): Documentation of default security settings and configurations.
- [Event Hub](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/event-hub): The event hub is a central system that processes a variety of events in a Strapi application
- [@strapi/core](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core): Server runtime of Strapi: the Strapi class, container, providers, registries, loaders, Document Service, HTTP server and core-api factories.
- [Localization provider](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/localization): Core depends on `Modules.Localization.Provider`, exposed through `strapi.localization`, for localization
- [MCP Server](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/mcp-server): How Strapi's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is registered, started, authenticated, and extended with tools, prompts, and resources.
- [Server-side telemetry](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/core/telemetry): How server-side analytics works in the monorepo — strapi.telemetry.send, event naming, rate limiting, and package metrics services.
- [Stream Lifecycle](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/engine/stream-lifecycle): Explanation of data transfer stream lifecycle and event flow.
- [Transfer Engine](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/engine): Conceptual guide to the data transfer engine
- [Introduction](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/overview): Overview of data transfer provider interfaces and implementations.
- [Source Providers](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/source-providers): Documentation of source providers for reading data transfers.
- [Destination Providers](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/destination-providers): Documentation of destination providers for writing data transfers.
- [Overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/strapi-file/overview): Overview of Strapi file-based data transfer provider.
- [Strapi File Structure](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/strapi-file/file-structure): Documentation of Strapi file transfer format and structure.
- [Source](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/strapi-file/source): Guide to using Strapi file provider as a data source.
- [Destination](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/strapi-file/destination): Guide to using Strapi file provider as a data destination.
- [Overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/local-strapi/overview): Overview of local Strapi instance data transfer provider.
- [Source](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/local-strapi/source): Guide to using local Strapi instance as a data source.
- [Destination](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/local-strapi/destination): Guide to using local Strapi instance as a data destination.
- [Overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/remote-strapi/overview): Overview of remote Strapi instance data transfer provider.
- [Websocket](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/remote-strapi/websocket): WebSocket protocol documentation for remote Strapi data transfer.
- [Source](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/remote-strapi/source): Guide to using remote Strapi instance as a data source.
- [Destination](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer/providers/remote-strapi/destination): Guide to using remote Strapi instance as a data destination.
- [@strapi/data-transfer](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/data-transfer): Streaming engine and providers that export, import and transfer Strapi data between files, directories and instances.
- [Polymorphic relations](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database/relations/polymorphic-relations): Storage, read/write paths, and document service behavior for morph* relations
- [Reordering](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database/relations/reordering): Conceptual guide to relations reordering in the Database
- [Transactions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database/transactions): Conceptual guide to transactions in Strapi
- [Migrations](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database/migrations): Conceptual guide to migrations in Strapi
- [Lifecycles](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database/lifecycles): TypeScript types for content-type lifecycle hooks
- [@strapi/database](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/database): Database layer on top of Knex: model metadata, schema sync, migrations, queries, relations, lifecycles and transactions.
- [@strapi/email](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/email): Core plugin that sends emails through a configurable provider and adds an admin settings page to check the setup.
- [Technologies](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/technologies): Technologies and frameworks used in Strapi OpenAPI implementation.
- [Architecture](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/architecture): Architecture overview of Strapi OpenAPI generation and processing.
- [Usage](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/usage): Guide to using OpenAPI specifications in Strapi.
- [Overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/overview): Overview of contributing to Strapi OpenAPI module.
- [Routes Provider](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/routes-provider): Documentation of routes provider in OpenAPI contribution.
- [Routes Matcher Rule](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/routes-matcher-rule): Documentation of routes matcher rule in OpenAPI contribution.
- [Assemblers](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/assemblers): Documentation of assemblers in OpenAPI generation.
- [Context Factory](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/context-factory): Documentation of context factory in OpenAPI module.
- [Processors](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/processors): Documentation of processors in OpenAPI generation.
- [Testing](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi/contributing/testing): Guide to testing OpenAPI module contributions.
- [@strapi/openapi](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/openapi): Generates OpenAPI documents for Strapi applications through providers, matchers, assemblers and processors.
- [Permission Engine](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/permissions/engine): Conceptual guide to the permission engine
- [@strapi/permissions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/permissions): Permission engine built on CASL. It takes action and condition providers and generates abilities from a list of permissions.
- [Review Workflows](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/review-workflows/backend): Review workflow technical design
- [Review Workflows](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/review-workflows/settings): Guide for review workflows in settings.
- [Review Workflows](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/review-workflows/content-manager): Guide for review workflows in the content-manager.
- [@strapi/review-workflows](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/review-workflows): Enterprise plugin that adds workflow stages and assignees to content entries, with stage-based permissions.
- [Overview](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/strapi/commands/overview): Overview of Strapi CLI commands and usage.
- [Build](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/strapi/commands/build): Documentation of the Strapi build command.
- [Develop](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/strapi/commands/develop): Documentation of the Strapi develop command.
- [@strapi/strapi](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/strapi): Framework entry package: the strapi CLI, the admin build tooling, and re-exports of @strapi/core and @strapi/types.
- [@strapi/types](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types): Shared TypeScript types for Strapi internals: server runtime, schemas, UIDs, documents and public registries.
- [Philosophy](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/philosophy): Philosophy and design principles of Strapi type system.
- [Schema](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/concepts/schema): Explanation of schema concepts in Strapi type system.
- [UID](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/concepts/uid): Documentation of UID identifiers in Strapi type system.
- [Public Registries](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/concepts/public-registry): Documentation of the public type registry in Strapi.
- [Concepts](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/concepts): The building blocks of the Strapi type system, from schemas and UIDs to public registries.
- [CheatSheet](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system/cheatsheet): Quick reference guide for Strapi type system concepts.
- [Type System](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/types/type-system): Principles, concepts and cheatsheet for the TypeScript type system of Strapi.
- [Providers](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/upload/backend/providers): Documentation of upload provider implementations.
- [MIME type validation](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/upload/backend/mime-validation): Guide to MIME type validation in file uploads.
- [@strapi/upload](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/upload): Upload plugin: the Media Library, file and folder storage, image processing, and upload providers.
- [Async utils functions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/utils/async): Utility functions for handling asynchronous operations.
- [@strapi/utils](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/utils): Shared server helpers for Strapi packages: hooks, providers, errors, schema traversal, sanitize and validate.
- [traverseEntity](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/core/utils/traverse-entity): Utility functions for traversing entity structures.
- [@strapi/generators](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/generators/generators): Code generators for Strapi APIs and plugins
- [Packages](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages): Catalog of the workspace packages under packages/, with one page per package that mirrors the repository tree.
- [@strapi/plugin-cloud](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/cloud): Admin-only plugin that adds a Deploy page with Strapi Cloud deployment instructions.
- [@strapi/plugin-color-picker](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/color-picker): Adds a color custom field that stores a HEX string and shows a color picker in the admin panel.
- [@strapi/plugin-documentation](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/documentation): Generates an OpenAPI document from routes and content types and serves it with Swagger UI at /documentation.
- [@strapi/plugin-graphql](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/graphql): Server plugin that builds a GraphQL schema from content types and serves it through Apollo Server.
- [@strapi/i18n](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/i18n): Adds locales and localized documents to content types, with Content Manager tools, locale permissions and API support.
- [@strapi/plugin-sentry](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/sentry): Server plugin that starts Sentry, reports errors thrown during HTTP requests, and exposes a sentry service.
- [@strapi/plugin-users-permissions](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/plugins/users-permissions): Content API authentication and authorization with users, roles, permissions, JWT and OAuth providers.
- [@strapi/provider-email-amazon-ses](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/email-amazon-ses): Amazon SES provider for strapi email
- [@strapi/provider-email-mailgun](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/email-mailgun): Mailgun provider for strapi email plugin
- [@strapi/provider-email-nodemailer](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/email-nodemailer): Nodemailer provider for Strapi
- [@strapi/provider-email-sendgrid](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/email-sendgrid): Sendgrid provider for strapi email
- [@strapi/provider-email-sendmail](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/email-sendmail): Sendmail provider for strapi email
- [@strapi/provider-upload-aws-s3](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/upload-aws-s3): AWS S3 provider for strapi upload
- [@strapi/provider-upload-cloudinary](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/upload-cloudinary): Cloudinary provider for strapi upload
- [@strapi/provider-upload-local](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/providers/upload-local): Local provider for strapi upload
- [api-tests](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/api-tests): Testing utilities for API integration tests
- [eslint-config-custom](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/eslint-config-custom): ESLint configuration for Strapi packages
- [@strapi/logger](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/logger): Strapi's logger built with Winston
- [oxlint-config](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/oxlint-config): Shared Oxlint configuration for the Strapi monorepo
- [tsconfig](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/tsconfig): Shared TypeScript configurations for Strapi packages
- [@strapi/typescript-utils](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/typescript): TypeScript support utilities for Strapi applications
- [@strapi/upgrade](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/upgrade): CLI tool to upgrade Strapi applications
- [vitest-config](https://contributor.strapi.io/packages/utils/vitest-config): Shared Vitest configuration for Strapi unit tests
